### Rescued from Sodom
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/rescued-sodom
Passage: Genesis 19:16
Points:
- Scorners who treat divine warnings as a joke bring about their own ruin.
- Lot hesitated to depart, requiring angels to forcefully lead him out solely by God's mercy.
- Lot's plea to escape to Zoar revealed an enduring desire for personal comfort over complete obedience.
- Lot exemplifies a worldly believer whose genuine faith is clouded by attachment to an ungodly culture.
- Christians must guard against materialism and avoid clinging to the decaying standards of the world.
